title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5.1, section 6 (Jones Lake and Lorenzetta Forest Service Roads)
heading: Jones Lake and Lorenzetta Forest Service Roads
sourceText:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Jones Lake and Lorenzetta Forest Service Roads
6 Those portions of M.U. 2-3 being all Crown land within 400 m of the midline of the following roads, including any spur roads: (a)Jones Lake Forest Service Road; (b)Lorenzetta Forest Service Road. [am. B.C. Reg. 115/2018, App. 1, s. 5.]
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
